The Parent's Argument, Shaped and Unshaped

Source: R/distrib_penalty.R
dp_arg.Rd

dp_arg reshapes \(D\beta\) into the argument the parent reads – the vector itself for a univariate parent, one row per block for a multivariate one – and dp_flat undoes it.

Usage

dp_arg(pen, t)

dp_flat(pen, g)

Arguments

pen

A DistribPenalty object.

t

The mapped coefficient vector.

g

The parent's answer, a vector or a matrix of one row per block.

Value

A vector or a matrix.

Details

The blocks are the SUCCESSIVE stretches of \(D\beta\), so the reshaping fills by row: block \(i\) occupies positions \((i-1)p+1, \dots, ip\). That is the order a grouped design assembles its coefficients in, and the order \(I_m \otimes \Sigma\) assumes.
